title: Trader traceability information for marketplaces
summary: An online platform allowing distance contracts with consumers must obtain and verify the trader's identity, contact details, payment account, trade register entry and a self-certification that only compliant products are offered.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 on a Single Market For Digital Services
sources.note: Article reference inherited from 02-technical-plan §5.1/§5.2, which itself states that article numbers must be verified against EUR-Lex before publishing. Not yet verified.
